events.title: 첼시 sign defender Tony Dorigo from 애스턴 빌라 for £475,000.
노팅엄 포리스트 's Dutch midfielder Johnny Metgod signs for 토트넘 홋스퍼 in a £250,000 deal.
England goalkeeper Peter Shilton moves to 더비 카운티 from 사우샘프턴 for £90,000.

맨체스터 유나이티드 sign 아스널 defender Viv Anderson for £250,000. Former 퀸스 파크 레인저스 and England forward Gerry Francis , 36, is appointed player-manager of Third Division side 브리스틀 로버스 as successor to Bobby Gould who moved to 윔블던 last month.
Peter Beardsley becomes the most expensive player to move between British clubs when he joins 리버풀 in a £1.9 million deal from 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 .

Ray Harford , first-team coach, is promoted to the manager's seat at 루턴 타운 following the resignation of John Moore . 코번트리 시티 more than double their record transfer outlay with a £750,000 move for 첼시 striker David Speedie .
포츠머스 prepare for their return to the First Division with a £60,000 move for 렉섬 midfielder Barry Horne .

토트넘 홋스퍼 and England midfielder Glenn Hoddle moves to AS AS 모나코 for £800,000 on a three-year contract. 맨체스터 유나이티드 get a £300,000 insurance payout from The Football Association following the injury enforced retirement of 29-year-old goalkeeper Gary Bailey .

스컨소프 유나이티드 announce that they will leave the Old Showground at the end of the season and move to a new stadium in the town 's suburbs – the first relocation of a Football League club since 사우스엔드 유나이티드 moved to Roots Hall in 1955.
맨체스터 시티 are reported to have made an approach for out of favour 리버풀 midfielder John Wark . 왓퍼드 sign prolific Reading striker Trevor Senior for £325,000.
In second ever FIFA U16 World Championship , the Soviet Union beat the surprise winners of two years ago, Nigeria , on penalties.
윔블던 sign defenders Terry Phelan from 스완지 시티 for £100,000 and Eric Young from Brighton & Hove Albion for £70,000. 첼시 striker Kerry Dixon withdraws his transfer request.
맨체스터 유나이티드 complete the signing of striker Brian McClair after a tribunal orders them to pay £850,000 for the striker, originally valued at £2million by 셀틱 .
